variantrecords:1: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Left path. Solve the two-eyes puzzle (blue sack right of the north door, yellow sack in the far south-east corner). After the teleporter, clear the enemies and open the door hidden behind the rubble before Nanamo opens the gate.
variantrecords:2: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Left path. Solve the two-eyes puzzle (blue sack right of the north door, yellow sack in the far south-east corner), then let Nanamo open the gate without interfering.
variantrecords:3: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Left path. Fail the two-eyes puzzle. In the next room, hit every cotton spore while fighting the enemies.
variantrecords:4: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Left path. Fail the two-eyes puzzle, then carry on while avoiding every cotton spore.
variantrecords:5: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Right path. Go left on the lift; at the blocking door pick the first answer, "The blessed spark".
variantrecords:6: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Right path. Go left on the lift; at the blocking door pick the second answer, "The sacred fire".
variantrecords:7: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Right path. After the first boss take the lift right; kill the drakes from biggest to smallest (father, mother, brother, sister, drakeling). After the wraiths, use the Myrrh Incense Burner on the right of that room, then the sarcophagus, and defeat the boss.
variantrecords:8: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Middle path. Fail the scale puzzle, fight the last boss and pull the right lever.
variantrecords:9: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: finish the dungeon by the route that ends with this record
variantrecords:10: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Middle path. Solve the scales (helm on the left, fruit on the right); in the next chamber use the Nald statue.
variantrecords:11: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Middle path. Solve the scales (helm on the left, fruit on the right); in the next chamber use the Thal statue.
variantrecords:12: the Sil'dihn Subterrane: Right path, secret boss (Thorne Knight). Do the Myrrh route: drakes from biggest to smallest, then the incense burner. At the sarcophagus, target it and use /bow, /respect, /vpose, /kneel in that order, then defeat the boss.
variantrecords:13: Mount Rokkon: Left path. In the crystal ball room use the orb without turning the statues. In the next room close the case after Hancock looks at it.
variantrecords:14: Mount Rokkon: Left path. In the crystal ball room use the orb without turning the statues. In the next room leave the case alone after Hancock looks at it.
variantrecords:15: Mount Rokkon: Left path. Turn the Seiryu statue to face east (toward Suzaku) and the Suzaku statue to face south (the big doors), then use the orb. In the last pack of the Upper Pagoda, let the Apa finish casting Water III before killing it.
variantrecords:16: Mount Rokkon: Left path. Turn the Seiryu statue to face east (toward Suzaku) and the Suzaku statue to face south (the big doors), then use the orb. In the last pack of the Upper Pagoda, kill or interrupt the Apa before it casts Water III.
variantrecords:17: Mount Rokkon: Middle path. Before the second boss, clear the enemies and answer "Deal" when asked whether to spare the baboon.
variantrecords:18: Mount Rokkon: Middle path. Before the second boss, clear the enemies and answer "Think about it" when asked whether to spare the baboon.
variantrecords:19: Mount Rokkon: Middle path. After the tiger, climb the crates and overhangs and pull the rope at the top; wait upstairs for Hancock, then kill the lantern enemies normally.
variantrecords:20: Mount Rokkon: Right path. Ignore the Rokkon Sentinel; after the first boss, touch all four Stones of Protection along the way.
variantrecords:21: Mount Rokkon: Right path. Ignore both the Rokkon Sentinel and the Stones of Protection.
variantrecords:22: Mount Rokkon: Right path. Talk to the Rokkon Sentinel to free the dogu from the tree; use /easternbow at the unmarked shrine by the fallen tree and place the dogu there; later use the Iwakura.
variantrecords:23: Mount Rokkon: Right path. Talk to the Rokkon Sentinel to free the dogu from the tree; use /easternbow at the unmarked shrine by the fallen tree and place the dogu there; later use the Ancient Tree instead of the Iwakura.
variantrecords:24: Mount Rokkon: Middle path, secret boss (Enenra). After the tiger, climb the crates and pull the rope; wait upstairs for Hancock. Pull the three lantern enemies down the stairs and kill each one while it faces one of the three unlit lanterns by the yellow-patterned wall (they cast a cone when they die).
variantrecords:25: Aloalo Island: Left path. Refuse Matsya's request to fish, and do not help Zozone (he runs off at zero health).
variantrecords:26: Aloalo Island: Left path. Refuse Matsya's request to fish, and keep Zozone alive (heal him, Variant Cure works, or hold the enemies' attention).
variantrecords:27: Aloalo Island: Left path. Let Matsya fish; later dig in the patch of sand on the right for a Southern Sow Bug.
variantrecords:28: Aloalo Island: Left path. Let Matsya fish; later search the mound of rocks on the left for a Southern Worm.
variantrecords:29: Aloalo Island: Middle path. Go straight through, kill the enemies and interact with nothing.
variantrecords:30: Aloalo Island: Middle path. At the second and third packs after the first boss, walk into the red-flowered bushes and scare off the armadillos at the end of each hidden path.
variantrecords:31: Aloalo Island: Middle path. After the first boss kill the treant first, then every caterpillar on the sigil. In the last pack, do not hit J'jhimei behind the left wood golem; wait for the golems to wake.
variantrecords:32: Aloalo Island: Middle path. After the first boss kill the treant first, then every caterpillar on the sigil. In the last pack, also hit J'jhimei behind the left wood golem.
variantrecords:33: Aloalo Island: Right path. Accept Statice's offer, use the portal she makes, and walk into her whoopee-cushion prank.
variantrecords:34: Aloalo Island: Right path. Accept Statice's offer, use the portal and kill the six raptors; in the next hallway take the vine-covered tunnel on the right to the crocodile room, avoiding the whoopee cushion. (Also works by refusing her three times, opening no chests, ignoring the animal statues and pulling the lever.)
variantrecords:35: Aloalo Island: Right path. Refuse Statice's offer three times, open a treasure box and kill the mimics, ignore the animal statues and pull the lever.
variantrecords:36: Aloalo Island: Right path, secret boss (Loquloqui). Refuse Statice three times and do the three statue rituals (one minute each, only the player with the buff): Sparrow: /say O dancer of the skies, hear me. then /blowkiss, circle once clockwise (turtle, whale, sparrow), /dance. Whale: /say O messenger from beyond the horizon, hear me. circle once clockwise (sparrow, turtle, whale) then once counterclockwise, /dance. Turtle: /say O wayfarer of land and sea, hear me. circle twice counterclockwise (sparrow, whale, turtle), /bow. Follow Matsya through the secret passage, take the leather sack from Whasbyrm, and before the last boss set the statues: sparrow farthest, whale middle, turtle nearest.
variantrecords:37: The Merchant's Tale: Left path. After the first boss, use the damaged fence by the spoils coffer; wait at the bird nest and hit the Willful Wind before it finishes casting Flee.
variantrecords:38: The Merchant's Tale: Left path. After the first boss, use the damaged fence by the spoils coffer; let the Willful Wind take the apple and carry on.
variantrecords:39: The Merchant's Tale: Left path. After the first boss, go through the gate and let the Wisp's area attack hit you beside the damaged stone railing on the left; take the path through the broken railing.
variantrecords:40: The Merchant's Tale: Left path. After the first boss, go through the gate and carry on without interacting with anything.
variantrecords:41: The Merchant's Tale: Right path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "The seaweed won't steer us wrong."; let the goobbue's Inhale swallow all four clusters of colourful rocks.
variantrecords:42: The Merchant's Tale: Right path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "The seaweed won't steer us wrong."; kill the goobbue before it swallows all the rocks.
variantrecords:43: The Merchant's Tale: Right path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "I'd fancy a stroll on the beach."; after the first pack, use the Giant Conch Shell.
variantrecords:44: The Merchant's Tale: Right path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "I'd fancy a stroll on the beach."; leave the Giant Conch Shell alone and go on to the boss.
variantrecords:45: The Merchant's Tale: Middle path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "Let the mushrooms guide us true!"; make the Stone Puppet's Magnetic Rock (a small circle on its target) hit all three big rock clusters in the cave.
variantrecords:46: The Merchant's Tale: Middle path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "Let the mushrooms guide us true!"; kill the Stone Puppet without lighting the rock clusters.
variantrecords:47: The Merchant's Tale: Middle path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "Floating rocks warrant a closer look."; stand by each of the three big rocks on the platforms until they glow (a path on the west side reaches the upper one).
variantrecords:48: The Merchant's Tale: Middle path. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "Floating rocks warrant a closer look."; keep away from the big rocks.
variantrecords:49: The Merchant's Tale: Right path, secret record. After the first boss tell Y'nazqha "The seaweed won't steer us wrong." At the Shimmering Stage altar before the seaweed barrier, /bow to raise five coloured panels, /say I am returned! and stand on four panels in order: coral (green), conch (purple), starfish (magenta), pearl (blue).

collection:1: Yo-kai Watch collaboration event (time-limited; last run August to October 2026): start the quest “A Complete Game Changer” from the Poor-heeled Youth in Ul'dah - Steps of Nald (9.2, 9.1) at level 15 or higher

Wear the Yo-kai Watch and earn Silver or Gold in FATEs in A Realm Reborn, Heavensward or Stormblood zones for Yo-kai Medals; trade them to Nohi in the Gold Saucer (5.2, 6.9) for this Yo-kai minion (the first costs 1 medal, later ones 3)
With the minion out, the same FATEs can also drop its Legendary Medals for the matching Yo-kai weapon
